sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Space Junk Jump is a timing-based game where you control a character that must jump through a void filled with obstacles. The game's simplicity is part of its charm, as it requires quick reflexes and precise timing to avoid being hit by junk and debris.

The game's controls are easy to use, with a simple mouse or keyboard layout that makes it accessible to players of all ages. You can use the arrow keys or WASD keys to move left or right, and the space bar to jump.

As you play the game, you'll notice that the obstacles become increasingly difficult to avoid. The junk and debris are constantly moving, and you'll need to anticipate their movements to survive. This requires a combination of quick reflexes and strategy, as you'll need to time your jumps carefully to avoid being hit.
